copy.tagline: 管理 Flutter 应用中的 Provider 状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 Provider 管理 Flutter 应用状态
copy.tagline_en: Manage Provider state in Flutter apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Provider for state management in Flutter

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会依据 provider 包的最佳实践，为你提供 Flutter 中状态管理的代码示例，包括设置 MultiProvider、使用 ChangeNotifierProvider、消费状态、利用 ProxyProvider 处理依赖，以及避免常见错误。
howto.when: 当你询问 Flutter 中 provider 包的设置、状态消费、重构优化、ProxyProvider 使用，或从已废弃的 provider 功能迁移时，Claude 会触发此技能。

say.text: 如何在Flutter中用MultiProvider设置多个状态？
用Provider时，怎么在回调中读取状态而不重建？
如何使用ProxyProvider让一个Provider依赖另一个？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows the provider package best practices to give you code examples for setting up MultiProvider, using ChangeNotifierProvider, consuming state, leveraging ProxyProvider for dependencies, and avoiding common pitfalls.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about provider setup, state consumption, rebuild optimization, ProxyProvider usage, or migration from deprecated provider features in Flutter.

say_en.text: How do I set up multiple states with MultiProvider in Flutter?
say_en.note: Claude shows the MultiProvider nesting pattern.

say_en.text: How can I read state without rebuilding when using Provider?
How do I use ProxyProvider to make one provider depend on another?
say_en.note: Claude gives an update example for ProxyProvider.
